message:
docs(ledger): F-23, a window procedure path that returns nothing

Recorded, not fixed -- the verifier found it while checking the picker work and asked
for a ledger entry, since it has nothing to do with finishing that.

WM_TIMER falls out of the switch with break when the timer is neither of the two this
window sets, and there is no return after the switch. The return type is LRESULT, so
that path is undefined. MSVC has been saying so on every build of every target that
compiles the file: warning C4715, confirmed by running it.

Unreachable today. Only two timers target this window and both return. The cost lands on
whoever adds a third and silently gets a garbage LRESULT for a message DefWindowProcW
should have handled. It predates this branch -- the same break is in 11e9329.

Worth noting what kind of miss this is: the compiler was reporting it the whole time and
nobody read it. That is the fourth instance this round of a signal that existed and went
unread.
